name: NH Roma Villa Carpegna
description: Set in a lovely private park, the NH Roma Villa Carpegna hotel enjoys a quiet location, yet is only a short walk away from the Vatican and the St. Peter's Basilica. The Cipro metro station is 15-minutes away on foot, while the no. 31 bus stops close to the hotel and provides guests easy access to all of Rome's main attractions, including the Trastevere neighborhood with its shops, restaurants, and bars. Free parking is available on-site, and there is a shuttle service available to the city center too. There are 201 rooms at NH Roma Villa Carpegna. For the more modern comforts, guests enjoy free Wi-Fi, air-conditioning, TVs, a mini-bar, and rain effect showers. Each morning, NH Roma Villa Carpegna serves up a fresh and delicious breakfast spread, including a variety of sweet and savory dishes, accompanied by hot and cold beverages. Later in the day, try some of the best traditional and regional cuisine at the Il Gelsomino restaurant. Guests can also wind down with a carefully crafted cocktail at our lobby bar, La Magnolia, or relax and re-energize at the fitness center. Functions can be held at one of our 12 meeting rooms holding up to 350 people.
